title: Assignment 3: Add secure authentication.

rows.to: Can the student explain why it works?
rows.detail: Oral walkthrough of the request path: where the token is read, what is validated, and why.

rows.to: Can they say what the tests miss?
rows.detail: Ask for the missing negative test — e.g. a token issued for another audience.

rows.to: Can they change it when the requirement changes?
rows.detail: Live modification under time limit, with AI allowed or off by checkpoint.
Design rationale and process log: what they asked the agent, what they rejected, and why.

sticky: New requirement: accept only tokens issued for shop-api. You have 15 minutes.
case: Anthropic redesigned its own take-home after Claude Opus 4.5 matched top candidates within 2 hours.
quote: The original worked because it resembled real work. The replacement works because it simulates novel work.
headline: Are we developing people who can produce an answer — or engineers who can tell whether the answer is right?
